findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is e2397664410c8109add14bb8f70f4a6f77418116de1e8545ac08d3800fa392aa; all 2 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The official PDF is 378,650 bytes with SHA-256 91df8414af2aee0c7609545f4a31385f54f46f06e980a87e89d9a99a8f85dff6 and contains 30 PDF pages; its footer says printed July 2024 and its heading identifies tax years 2025 and 2026.

Whole-PDF page 21, printed page 19, says acquisition and development costs may bear no relation to present worth and that, as a general rule, P&A does not employ the cost approach for mineral interests.

Whole-PDF pages 21-22, printed pages 19-20, describe actual transactions as market evidence, identify limited disclosed data, required sale-condition knowledge, and multi-asset allocation complications, and say P&A rarely employs a rigorous market approach as a general rule.

Whole-PDF page 22, printed page 20, says the income approach most readily lends itself to mineral-interest appraisal, that P&A predominantly relies on it as a general rule, and that a result is no better than input reliability.
